profile.headline: I Solve Problems
profile.summary:
Software Engineering Lead with 18+ years of experience in full-stack development, specializing in JavaScript and popular frameworks such as React and AngularJS. My extensive background spans back-end to front-end, delivering high-quality solutions for various industries. I hold a Master of Science in Software Engineering and am a Certified Scrum Master, showcasing my commitment to staying up-to-date with the latest technologies and agile methodologies. With a strong foundation in software engineering principles, I excel in collaborative environments, driving projects from concept to completion with a focus on scalability, performance, and maintainability. Let's connect and explore opportunities to innovate and drive success in the tech industry!

Long-term goal: Take over the world, but in the meantime, I am looking to grow my skills and career.

Specialties: 
Javascript/Typescript (including React, Angular, Redux,)
PHP (Symfony, CodeIgniter)
Python
SQL - (MySQL, PostgreSQL, MS SQL Server)
Linux/UNIX
Mac OS X
Scrum Team/Process Management & Improvement

positions.title: Senior UI Engineer & Scrum Master
positions.description: Angular web app development with Redux and Scrum process management.
positions.insights: Skills: AngularJS · Web Components · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · React.js · JavaScript

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer & Scrum Master
positions.description:
Responsible for full lifecycle design and development of AirWatch’s portal applications that allow for automation of processes and access for external customers. Work in a fast paced, Agile-based environment and focus on cutting edge distributed SaaS-based applications. Our engineers have the opportunity to expand existing capabilities while engineering new projects from scratch.

* Work as an integral member of the myAirWatch product team; a small, autonomous group within the Research and Development Team at AirWatch

* Work side by side with UI and other developers in producing innovative applications that support the  optimization of customer experiences with the  myAirWatch product

* Translate business requirements into elegant designs to engineer through to a finished product for release

* Maintain usable development and test environments with Git and other tools to deliver applications in a reliable and efficient process 

* Researching industry standards for advanced technology to leverage in design and development.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developing an enterprise-level solution in Paid Media to help clients manage Facebook ads and custom audiences.
Responsible for diagnosing, prioritizing and resolving/coordinating critical bug fixes across application development teams. 
Act as the liaison between the product development team and customer support group as well as participate in the design and coding of end-to-end applications including database models, application logic, and presentation layers.
Mentor junior team members and act as technology lead.
The technology stack includes Ruby on Rails, MySQL, JQuery, and Backbone.js, while following Agile development methodology principles.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Build and maintain web application marketing automation system. 

Responsibilities:
Application development in PHP on Symfony MVC Framework
Database and query optimizations in MySQL
Functional and unit testing
Server administration on linux machines
Technical Product Support

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Cooperate with hospital and university faculty and staff to create more efficient procedures in the Cancer Center and the Medical Oncology Department.  Work solo or on teams (with experience as a team leader) through all steps in the Software Development Life Cycle to build web applications in an open-source environment, using technology such as Linux, PHP, Apache, MySQL, PostgreSQL, Bash scripting, Perl, Subversion, and Java).  Administer a Virtual Windows server that runs IIS and MS SQL Server and functions as a networked file server.  Perform analyses of cancer center data in MS SQL Server to build reports for Administrators.  Responsible for ensuring department and cancer center systems operation and understanding business needs and data requirements in order to meet functional and reporting needs.
